headlines.title: Tony Robbins: How to make yourself irreplaceable in the AI era
headlines.summary: Author, entrepreneur, and philanthropist Tony Robbins explains to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi why people are being replaced by those who know how to use AI rather than by AI itself, and why the best coders are now running 50 AI agents at once.

headlines.title: Tony Robbins: 4 rules the world's greatest investors follow
headlines.summary: Author, entrepreneur, and philanthropist Tony Robbins sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to break down the four things every elite investor does in common, and why you should run your money like a side business.

headlines.title: Rivian CEO talks robotaxis: 'I don't think it's the end of car ownership'
headlines.summary: As Rivian (RIVN) continues to build its own R2 robotaxi with Uber (UBER), Rivian founder and CEO RJ Scaringe joins Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference to share his thoughts on the future of robotaxis, car ownership, and more.

headlines.title: Is Uber's Expansion of Delivery Tie-Up With MCD a Growth Catalyst?
headlines.summary: UBER's expanded McDonald's partnership across 14 markets aims to boost delivery volumes, accelerate Uber Direct adoption and strengthen customer engagement.

headlines.title: Google Could Buy Uber to Win the Robotaxi Wars, Reuters Columnist Argues
headlines.summary: Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) could buy Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER), combining its Waymo robotaxi business with America’s largest ride-hailing network, Reuters Breakingviews columnist Jennifer Saba argued Tuesday. The deal could benefit both companies.

description: Uber Technologies, Inc. develops and operates proprietary technology applications in the United States, Canada, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. The company operates through three segments: Mobility, Delivery, and Freight. The Mobility segment connects consumers with a range of transportation modalities, such as ridesharing, carsharing, micromobility, rentals, public transit, taxis, and other modalities; and offers riders in a variety of vehicle types, as well as financial partnerships products and advertising services. The Delivery segment allows consumers to search for and discover restaurants to grocery, alcohol, convenience, and other retailers, as well as order a meal or other items, and either pick-up at the restaurant or have it delivered; and provides Uber direct, a white-label delivery-as-a-service for retailers and restaurants, as well as advertising services. The Freight segment manages transportation and logistics networks, which connects shippers and carriers in digital marketplace, including carriers upfronts, pricing, and shipment booking; and offers on-demand platform to automate logistics end-to-end transactions for small-and medium-sized businesses to global enterprises. Uber Technologies, Inc. has strategic partnership with Mews to embed ride booking, real-time tracking and integrated billing directly into the Mews platform. The company was formerly known as Ubercab, Inc. and changed its name to Uber Technologies, Inc. in February 2011. Uber Technologies, Inc. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
